
**Language:** [English](s5c-release-notes-snippet.en.md) | [Simplified Chinese](s5c-release-notes-snippet.md)
AgentSQL v0.4 B6 introduces group-commit batch submission and bounded backpressure for audit chain writing: concurrent append aggregates submissions in a controlled queue, and uses the new error code `AUDIT_OVERLOADED` to explicitly fail when safe admission cannot continue to avoid unbounded queuing. S5c completed the combined verification of sustained offered 2000/s × 30 minutes and burst offered 5000/s × 60 seconds under the limit of `postgres:18` and 2 CPU/2048 MiB; after running, PostgreSQL saved a total of 3,799,725 audit records, all of which were allow, non-null error codes were 0, and `chain_seq` from 1 to 3,799,725 Consecutively unique, `head_seq` for the ACTIVE keyless chain is consistent with the total number of commits. The official burst window added 199,725 rows (approximately 3329/s), no `AUDIT_OVERLOADED` was returned, and the excess was smoothed by group-commit. The short window measured for the same binary and the same 2C2G environment is: PostgreSQL sustained 2007/s, appended p95/p99 24.64/34.02 ms; burst 4874/s, p95/p99 182.03/238.72 ms; SQLite 500/s, p95/p99 20.87/22.67 ms; PG backfill 1160 rows/s, all 0 errors and the queue is reset to zero after the load is stopped.

Trust boundary: The official 30-minute scenario-by-scenario goodput/delay is not persisted, and relevant judgments use short-window data in the same environment; SQLite 500/s × 10-minute results are not retained separately; the O(N) full recalculation Verify of about 3.8M rows is not completed within the collection window, and the existing formal evidence covers the sequence continuously and uniquely, and the chain head is consistent with the number of submissions. The full Verify performance will be recorded on a fixed 10^5 rows as the final item, with the target of PostgreSQL ≤30 seconds and SQLite ≤60 seconds; the periodic verification is streaming and the production database is incremental verification, so this release will not be blocked. The S5 capacity gate conclusion is **GO**.
